title: Variance of a Rademacher summand
statement: For every natural number $n$, every coefficient vector $a\in\bbr^n$, and every coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the variance under the uniform measure on $\{-1,1\}^n$ of the random variable $x\mapsto a_i x_i$ is $a_i^2$.
